name: Vanthorpe Voidcut Chrome Reveal Suit
description: A Tier 4 club and lounge outfit that exists at the exact intersection of corporate authority and deliberate transgression — the kind of suit that reads as professional from across the room and as something more dangerous up close. The jacket is single-button, structured, in deep midnight-blue synth-wool with a subtle self-pattern woven in near-black reactive thread that shifts geometry slowly — so slowly it takes several minutes of observation to confirm it's moving. The lapels are faced in mirror-chrome synth-leather, and the jacket's interior lining is holographic silver, visible as the wearer moves. Both sleeves terminate at the elbow in engineered cutoffs — clean, deliberate, chrome-edged — leaving the forearm fully exposed: for wearers with chrome augmentation this frames the hardware precisely; for those without it reads as equally intentional minimalism. A fitted high-collar shirt underneath is sheer black with a structured front placket, the collar designed with a wide notch at the back for neural port access. Trousers are slim, midnight-blue synth-wool matching the jacket, with a single holographic silver stripe down each outer seam that activates under UV. Footwear is clean, pointed ankle boots in mirror-chrome synth-leather matching the lapels. A single signet ring with a deep blue bioluminescent stone — dim but unmistakable — and no other accessories. The restraint is the statement.
functionality: Engineered elbow cutoffs with chrome-edged finish designed for chrome forearm and hand augment display. High-collar back notch provides clean neural port access. Reactive thread pattern in jacket fabric is passive — no power source, shifts via ambient temperature differential. Holographic silver trouser stripe is UV-activated. Interior lining is signal-diffuse, providing mild BCI privacy shielding in close contact.
what_it_says: You belong in the Spire lounges but you chose to come down one tier tonight because you wanted to be the most dangerous-looking person in the room without trying. The chrome edges on your jacket sleeves cost more than most people's rent and you cut the sleeves off yourself.
worn_by: corponation legal and compliance officers off-duty
Tier 3 professionals with Tier 4 aspirations and the budget to match
chrome-augmented professionals who use their hardware as social currency
manufacturer: Vanthorpe — Tier 4 tailoring house, bespoke and small production runs
story_hooks: The BCI privacy shielding in the jacket lining is not incidental — a Vanthorpe production insider reveals that a specific run of these jackets was commissioned by a corponation security division to create a wearable dead zone for clandestine meetings, and the buyer list is sealed.
Two people at the same Tier 4 lounge are wearing identical Vanthorpe suits — which should be impossible given the bespoke production model. One of them is not who they claim to be.

The bioluminescent stone in the signet ring is a geneware-derived biological gem — grown, not manufactured — and a Shelf biosalvage crew has identified it as cut from a source they know, a source that is supposed to be a protected person.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sharp, deliberately exposed silhouette that reads as high-authority boardroom from distance but transforms into something subversive and augmentation-forward up close. Single-button jacket with cropped sleeves creates an architectural frame for visible forearms—chrome hardware or bare skin becomes intentional statement. The overall effect is calculated minimalism masquerading as corporate formality.
physical_description.fit: Tailored precision throughout. Jacket is structured and close-fitted through the chest with subtle shoulder definition. High collar sits crisp and intentional. Trousers are slim and streamlined, terminating at the ankle boot line without break. The cropped sleeves at elbow are the only deliberately oversized element—a punctuation mark.
physical_description.primary_material: Deep midnight-blue synth-wool (jacket and trousers) with mirror-chrome synth-leather facing and trim. Sheer black structural shirt underneath. Chrome-edged sleeve terminations suggest reinforced ballistic composite at cut points.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, high-polish synth-wool with barely perceptible reactive thread weave that creates a slow-shifting self-pattern visible only under sustained observation. Mirror-chrome surfaces are flawless and reflective. Sheer shirt creates subtle transparency contrast. Chrome edges are sharp and geometrically precise.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: deep midnight-blue with near-black reactive threading that pulses geometry at imperceptible speed. Accent: mirror-chrome on lapels, sleeve edges, boot surfaces. Interior holographic silver lining catches light in fractured rainbow when jacket moves. Single bioluminescent blue stone on signet ring—dim, steady glow. Under UV: holographic silver seams on trouser legs activate with additional dimension.
physical_description.closures: Single chrome button closure at chest. Shirt features structured placket with subtle magnetic snap system. Boots use integrated friction-fit with micro-grip sole. No visible fasteners elsewhere—all closures are minimal and precise.
distinctive_features: Engineered elbow cutoffs with chrome-edged termination—deliberate architectural choice
Mirror-chrome faced lapels reflecting environment and wearer's movement
Holographic silver interior lining visible during motion—hidden luxury reveal
Sheer black high-collar shirt with wide rear notch for neural port access—functional augmentation accommodation
Reactive thread weaving through jacket that shifts geometry on multi-minute cycle—barely detectable wealth indicator
Holographic silver stripe down outer trouser seams that activates only under UV light—club environment detail
Deep blue bioluminescent signet ring—sole accessory, positioned as restraint statement
Mirror-chrome ankle boots with sharp pointed toe—echoes lapel treatment for visual cohesion
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 borderline: Vanthorpe is Tier 4 tailoring house, but this suit's price point and construction place it in Tier 1-2 collector territory. Worn by those with corporate authority who deliberately signal augmentation access and sub-culture familiarity.
physical_description.cultural_context: This is corpo-lounge wear for the augmented elite—people with decision-making authority who move between boardrooms and underground clubs. The exposed forearms frame chrome hardware as status symbol, while the suit's structure maintains plausible deniability as 'professional.' Wearing this announces: I have the credits to look this sharp, the augmentation to justify the cutoffs, and the social position to break dress codes deliberately.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new. Develops character through micro-scratches on mirror-chrome surfaces that collectors consider patina. Holographic lining eventually develops subtle clouding. The reactive threading never degrades—it's permanent. Bioluminescent stone maintains brightness indefinitely. This suit is maintained obsessively by owners; visible wear is considered damage rather than character.
